checks.text: The page shows the heading "Password Generator", a number field labelled "Length" with the value "16", and four checked checkboxes labelled "Lowercase", "Uppercase", "Digits" and "Symbols".
Clicking the button "Generate" puts a password that is exactly 16 characters long in the read-only field labelled "Password".
With only "Digits" checked and Length "8", Generate gives a password that matches `^[0-9]{8}$`.
With only "Lowercase" and "Uppercase" checked and Length "40", the password matches `^[A-Za-z]{40}$` and contains at least one lowercase letter and at least one uppercase letter.
With all four checkboxes unchecked, Generate shows the message "Choose at least one character set" and the Password field stays empty.
With Length "3", and again with Length "65", Generate shows the message "Length must be between 4 and 64" and the Password field stays empty.
Clicking Generate twice with Length "32" gives two different passwords.
After Generate with only "Digits" checked and Length "4" the page shows the text "Strength: Weak"; after Generate with all four checked and Length "20" it shows "Strength: Strong".
After setting Length to "24" and unchecking "Symbols", reloading the page still shows Length "24", "Symbols" unchecked and the other three checked.
